examples.title: Search and filter
examples.description: Toolbar for finding and narrowing table rows.
examples.behavior: Group table-scoped controls above the data they affect.
examples.qa: Search, filters and actions are visually distinct.

examples.title: Bulk actions
examples.description: Selection-aware toolbar for operating on multiple rows.
examples.behavior: Bulk actions appear only when selection exists and state the selected count.
examples.qa: Bulk action does not obscure primary table controls.

examples.title: Disabled toolbar
examples.description: Toolbar controls unavailable while data is loading or locked.
examples.behavior: Disable row-affecting controls together while preserving table context.

bulk-selection.trigger: One or more rows are selected
